modules.title: 切换系统开关，看页面动画怎样响应

items.title: 装饰动画减弱或停止
items.text: 旋转、大幅滑动、视差滚动这类纯装饰动效，在设置开启时应该停下。

items.title: 状态信息仍要清楚
items.text: 减少动效时可以停掉加载旋转，再用文字或进度表示仍在等待；保留信息不等于保留动画。

items.title: 用系统设置验证
items.text: 改完在系统设置里切换一次，看页面动画是否真的随之变化，才算验收。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: 减少动效表达用户希望减少非必要动态效果；实现可以减弱、停止或替换动画。无论选哪种方式，页面状态都要继续说清楚。

lessonPractice.title: 系统减少动效已开启，但页面的装饰动画仍在播放。该检查什么？

options.label: 响应系统偏好，减少非必要动效并保留清楚的状态信息
options.feedback: 对。根据系统偏好减少非必要动效；加载旋转可以停止，但仍要让用户看懂页面正在等待。再切换设置确认页面会响应。

options.label: 给每个动画加一个暂停按钮就够了
options.feedback: 按钮需要用户自己发现和点击；系统设置已经表达了偏好，页面应该自动响应。

options.label: 把加载说明和状态信息也一起删掉
options.feedback: 可以停止加载动画，但不能因此让用户看不出操作仍在进行；保留文字或进度等状态反馈。

en.title: An accessibility check flags that the page does not respond to the system's reduce motion setting. What should happen next?

options.label: Respond to the system preference, reduce nonessential motion, and keep the page state clear
options.feedback: Correct. A loading spinner can stop, but the page should still show that it is waiting. Toggle the preference to confirm the page responds.

options.label: Add a pause button to every animation
options.feedback: Buttons require users to find and click them; the system setting already expresses the preference and the page should respond automatically.

options.label: Delete the loading message and status information too
options.feedback: The spinner can stop, but the loading and status information should remain. Use static text or progress to show that the page is still waiting.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请让页面响应系统的减少动效偏好：开启时减少或替换非必要动画。加载图标可以停止旋转，但页面仍须用静态文字或进度说明等待状态。改完切换系统设置，确认页面会响应。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Make the page respond to the system's reduced-motion preference by reducing or replacing nonessential animation. A loading spinner may stop, but keep static text or progress feedback so the waiting state is clear. Toggle the system setting to verify the page responds.

learning.assumes: You have seen page animations, or heard of the system's reduce motion setting.
learning.outcome: You can toggle the system preference and check that the page reduces nonessential motion while keeping its state clear.

modules.title: Toggle the system switch and watch the page respond

items.title: Nonessential animation can change
items.text: When the preference is on, reduce, stop, or replace nonessential motion such as large movement or parallax.

items.title: Keep the page state clear
items.text: You can stop a loading spinner and use text or progress to show that work continues; keeping the information does not require keeping the animation.

items.title: Verify with the system setting
items.text: After changing it, toggle the system setting once and check whether the page animation actually follows—that is acceptance.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: Reduced motion expresses a preference for less nonessential movement; an implementation can reduce, stop, or replace animation. Whatever the choice, keep the page state clear.

distinctions.label: Pause button
distinctions.text: A pause button lets users control playback manually; reduce motion reads the system setting and reduces automatically—different triggers.

distinctions.label: Loading state
distinctions.text: Reduced motion can also stop a loading spinner; keep a static text or progress cue so users still know the page is waiting. Preserving the information does not require preserving the animation.
